# DSPOps

> DSPOps is Amazon DSP management software for UK Delivery Service Partners. It replaces the rota
> spreadsheet, the WhatsApp driver group and a stack of separate tools with one platform covering
> rota and dispatch, driver performance, van inspections, payroll and compliance — for van drivers,
> e-cargo bike riders and same-day delivery, in one account.

## What DSPOps is

- Built for UK Amazon DSPs, both 1.0 (vanless) and 2.0 operations.
- UK-hosted and GDPR-compliant. Driver data stays in the UK.
- Used by the owner and the OSM in the office, and by every driver through their own portal — on
  iOS, Android, or any phone browser.
- Amazon scorecard and route data sync in, so performance figures are not re-keyed.
- 7-day free trial, no card required.

## Platform

- [Amazon DSP management software](https://dspops.app/amazon-dsp-management-software): the whole
  platform in one page — scheduling, performance, inspections, payroll and compliance for a UK DSP.
- [DSP rota management](https://dspops.app/dsp-rota-management): drivers set their own availability
  in the portal, the weekly rota assembles itself, and last-minute cover is reassigned in two taps.
- [Driver performance tracking](https://dspops.app/driver-performance-tracking): Amazon scorecard
  metrics broken down per driver — DCR, DNR DPMO, POD, Contact Compliance and CDF.
- [Van inspection app](https://dspops.app/van-inspection-app): daily van checks with photos and
  video from any phone browser, with AI van damage detection and an audit trail for owners.
- [DSP invoicing and payroll](https://dspops.app/dsp-invoicing-payroll): driver pay calculated from
  Amazon's Work Summary Tool, with a one-click export for the accountant and every line traceable
  to a route.
- [DSP compliance tools](https://dspops.app/dsp-compliance-tools): right-to-work, licence, passport
  and vehicle MOT/insurance expiries tracked with automatic reminders and audit logs.
- [Micromobility delivery software](https://dspops.app/micromobility-delivery-software): e-cargo
  bike riders managed as their own person type. See below.
- [Blog](https://dspops.app/blog): guides for UK DSP owners on scorecards, rota, compliance,
  driver retention and Amazon micromobility.

## Micromobility — e-cargo bikes and on-foot rounds

DSPOps manages Amazon micromobility operations alongside van routes in the same account:

- **Riders are their own person type**, not van drivers with a note on them.
- **Morning and afternoon blocks on the same date.** A rider can work only the morning, only the
  afternoon, or both. Riders submit their availability per block in the driver portal.
- **Pay is calculated per block.**
- **Licence-free rider onboarding.** No driving licence and no DVLA check; right to work, ID,
  address history, medical declaration and agreements are all still required.
- **On-foot couriers are managed the same way as riders** — same onboarding, same blocks, same
  availability, same pay. There is no separate walker mode; walkers are handled as riders.
- **One rota and one compliance list** covering vans, bikes and on-foot rounds.

Read more: https://dspops.app/micromobility-delivery-software and
https://dspops.app/blog/amazon-micromobility-dsp-guide

## Same-day delivery

Same-day delivery (SDD) is included on every plan. SDD routes get their own wave view, a separate
driver pool, tighter SLA timers, late-stop alerts and SDD-specific pay rates. Owners running both
standard and same-day contracts see everything in one fleet-wide dashboard.

## Pricing

- **Starter** — £99/month, up to 30 drivers. Scheduling, driver management, fleet tracking, basic
  compliance, weekly payroll, driver portal, email support.
- **Professional** — £249/month, up to 100 drivers. Everything in Starter plus AI van damage
  detection, performance scorecards, advanced compliance, reports and analytics, capacity planning,
  Amazon sync and priority support.
- **Enterprise** — unlimited drivers and unlimited stations, for multi-station DSPs. Priced per
  active driver per month at a rate agreed with each client, billed on whichever is higher: the
  actual active driver count or an agreed minimum of at least 100 drivers. There is no published
  per-driver rate — email rashid@dspops.app for a quote.

Same-day delivery support and driver onboarding (CSV import, auto-generated driver portal logins)
are included on every plan and are never tier-gated.
